question:
**Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:**

The **fanon **rested on the Pope's shoulder during Mass.

options.text: The theologian lectured on the fanon's origin in Rome.
The tailor stitched the edge of the fanon carefully.
The critic analyzed Fanon's theory of postcolonial identity.
The cardinal wore the fanon over his chasuble.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fanon"** in the context of the sentence refers to a liturgical vestment used in the Roman Catholic Church, worn by the Pope during Mass. (धार्मिक वस्त्र)

 
 
• **Example: **The Pope adjusted the fanon before beginning the Mass ceremony.
 
 
 
• The homonym of "fanon" is "Fanon," which refers to Frantz Fanon, a notable philosopher and revolutionary known for his work on postcolonial studies and identity. (फ्रांत्ज़ फैनॉन, एक दार्शनिक और क्रांतिकारी)
 
 
• **Example: **The professor discussed Fanon's influence on postcolonial literature.
 
 
 
• Option 3 introduces the homonym "Fanon" (as a proper noun) in the context of analyzing postcolonial identity theory, which is unrelated to the liturgical object "fanon."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: **The theologian lectured on the fanon’s origin in Rome. (इस विकल्प में fanon का उपयोग धार्मिक वस्त्र के रूप में किया गया है।) (धार्मिक वस्त्र)

 
 
• **Example:** The fanon, as a liturgical object, is deeply rooted in Roman Catholic traditions.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: **The tailor stitched the edge of the fanon carefully. (इस विकल्प में fanon का उपयोग धार्मिक वस्त्र के संदर्भ में किया गया है।) (धार्मिक वस्त्र)
 
 
• **Example:** The tailor ensured that the fanon was stitched with fine craftsmanship.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: **The cardinal wore the fanon over his chasuble. (इस विकल्प में भी fanon का उपयोग धार्मिक वस्त्र के रूप में किया गया है।) (धार्मिक वस्त्र)
 
 
• **Example:** The cardinal’s attire included the fanon during the ceremonial event.
